title: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 01 number, 10 passengers (680Kg) machine room less Lift with SS Glass Cabin at Puducherry DGNSS Station.
summary: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of one 10-passenger (680 kg) machine-room-less lift with stainless steel glass cabin at Puducherry Lighthouse / DGNSS Station, including steel structural tower works.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Puducherry DGNSS Station (Puducherry Lighthouse)
sites.work: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of MRL passenger lift with SS glass cabin

scope.item: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 10 passengers (680Kg) machine room less Lift with SS Glass Cabin

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Percentage rate contract. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee NIL.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Open to lift manufacturing agencies without JV, or regular civil engineering contractors in JV consortium with a lift manufacturer

(A) Lift manufacturer with valid licence/registration from State CEIG or other State/Central licensing authority, experienced in fabrication and erection of steel structural tower for lift and lift installation to minimum height 30 m; OR (B) contractor registered in appropriate class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL etc in JV with lift manufacturer
Similar works in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% p.a.; certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer

Similar works: fabrication and erection of steel structural tower for lift and lift installation to min 30 m height, and civil works like RCC towers, steel structures, buildings, bridges, dams, water tanks; lift manufacturer (second party) must submit CEIG manufacturing licence
Bank solvency certificate for 40% of estimated cost
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 30% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2023
P&L and audited balance sheets for past five years ending 31 March 2023; ITRs and sales tax clearance for last three years
PAN/ITCC/GST; litigation/blacklisting disclosure; key personnel with PF numbers; list of tools & plants and shuttering materials

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure III), not-blacklisted declaration, relatives in MoPSW/DGLL list, Section IX technical evaluation documents, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VII)
specs: Machine room less (MRL) lift, 10 passengers / 680 kg, SS glass cabin
notes: NIT dated 04.07.2024; two-cover percentage rate tender; download/submission 08.07.2024 10:00 to 30.07.2024 15:00; opening 31.07.2024 15:00. Location printed as Puducherry Lighthouse, Puducherry. Section I only; no BOQ.
